Name: Fish Stuff For Shrimps - Fishing QoL Mod
Author: mushymato
Description:
[b]Adds some fishing QoL[/b]:

[list]
[*]BobberBarFishIcon: show the fish on the bobber bar, optionally hide any fish you haven't caught before.[/*]
[*]GuarenteedSpecificBait: try to make specific bait work all the time.[/*]
[*]OnlyFishConsumesBaitAndTackle: only fish consumes bait and tackle[/*]
[/list]
[b]Install[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod to Mods folder[/*]
[*]Can uninstall whenever[/*]
[/list]
[b]Config[/b]

You can enable/disable any feature individually.

[b][url=https://github.com/Mushymato/FishStuffForShrimps]Source Code[/url][/b]
